chunks: As for the manifestation of miracles indicating the validity of his Imamate during the Occultation, they are more numerous than can be counted
except that we will mention a portion of them
ai.seo_question: What are the miracles of the Imam during the Occultation?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi highlights that the miracles of the Imam during the Minor and Major Occultation are too numerous to count, serving as continuous divine proof (hujjah) for the Shia community in his absence. This section serves as a bridge to detailed accounts, emphasizing that the Imam’s authority remains active and verifiable despite his physical concealment from public view.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: With regard to the display of miracles from His Eminence, the Master of the Age (a.s) during occultation, which prove his Imamate are numerous to the limit that they cannot be computed.
However, we will mention only a few of them here.
